import pandas as pd

# 1. Get all n8n input items
data = _items

# 2. Create DataFrame
rows = [item["json"] for item in data]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# 3. Remove duplicate orders
df = df.drop_duplicates(
    subset=["order_id"],
    keep="first"
)

# 4. Clean text columns
text_columns = [
    "order_id",
    "customer_id",
    "product_id",
    "payment_status",
    "order_status",
    "region"
]

for col in text_columns:
    df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

# Empty strings → missing
df = df.replace(r"^\s*$", pd.NA, regex=True)

# 5. Clean date
df["order_date"] = pd.to_datetime(
    df["order_date"],
    errors="coerce"
)

# 6. Clean quantity
df["quantity"] = pd.to_numeric(
    df["quantity"],
    errors="coerce"
)

# Negative quantity → missing
df.loc[df["quantity"] < 0, "quantity"] = pd.NA

# 7. Clean order value
df["order_value"] = pd.to_numeric(
    df["order_value"],
    errors="coerce"
)

# Negative order value → missing
df.loc[df["order_value"] < 0, "order_value"] = pd.NA

# 8. Remove rows missing critical IDs/date
df = df.dropna(
    subset=[
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "product_id",
        "order_date"
    ]
)

# 9. Calculate value per unit
df["value_per_unit"] = (
    df["order_value"] / df["quantity"]
).round(2)

# Invalid quantity → null
df.loc[
    (df["quantity"].isna()) | (df["quantity"] <= 0),
    "value_per_unit"
] = pd.NA

# 10. Order value category
df["order_value_category"] = pd.cut(
    df["order_value"],
    bins=[
        -float("inf"),
        5000,
        15000,
        float("inf")
    ],
    labels=[
        "Low",
        "Medium",
        "High"
    ]
)

# 11. Date → string
df["order_date"] = df["order_date"].dt.strftime(
    "%Y-%m-%d"
)

# 12. Convert missing values to None
df = df.fillna("")

# 13. Convert DataFrame back to n8n items
return [
    {
        "json": row
    }
    for row in df.to_dict(orient="records")
]

    "stock_available",
    "reorder_level",
    "daily_demand"
]

for col in numeric_columns:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[col],
        errors="coerce"
    )

    df["stock_available"] < 0,
    "stock_available"
] = pd.NA

# Negative reorder level → missing

    df["reorder_level"] < 0,
    "reorder_level"
] = pd.NA

# Negative demand → missing

    df["daily_demand"] < 0,
    "daily_demand"
] = pd.NA

    df["last_restock_date"],
    errors="coerce"
)

# 7. Remove rows missing critical fields

    subset=[
        "product_id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "last_restock_date"
    ]
)

# 8. Calculate estimated days of stock

    df["stock_available"] / df["daily_demand"]
).round(2)

# Invalid / zero demand → empty
df.loc[
    (df["daily_demand"].isna()) |
    (df["daily_demand"] <= 0),
    "estimated_stock_days"
] = pd.NA

# 9. Create inventory status
df["inventory_status"] = "Healthy"

df.loc[
    df["stock_available"] <= df["reorder_level"],
    "inventory_status"
] = "Reorder Required"

df.loc[
    (df["stock_available"] > df["reorder_level"]) &
    (df["estimated_stock_days"] <= 7),
    "inventory_status"
] = "Low Stock"

# 10. Date → string
df["last_restock_date"] = (
    df["last_restock_date"]
    .dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
)

# 11. Round numeric values

df["estimated_stock_days"] = (
    df["estimated_stock_days"].round(2)
)

# 12. Convert missing values to empty string
df = df.fillna("")

# 13. Convert DataFrame back to n8n items
return [
    {
        "json": row
    }
    for row in df.to_dict(orient="records")
]

import pandas as pd

# n8n input
df = pd.DataFrame([item["json"] for item in _items])

# =========================
# ORDERS KPI
# =========================

total_orders = len(df)
total_revenue = round(df["order_value"].sum(), 2)

completed_orders = (df["order_status"] == "Completed").sum()
cancelled_orders = (df["order_status"] == "Cancelled").sum()

cancel_rate = round((cancelled_orders / total_orders) * 100, 2)

# =========================
# DELIVERY KPI
# =========================

delivered_orders = (df["delivery_status"] == "Delivered").sum()
delivery_success_rate = round((delivered_orders / total_orders) * 100, 2)

avg_delivery_cost = round(df["delivery_cost"].fillna(0).mean(), 2)

delay = df["delivery_delay_days"].fillna(0)

avg_delay_days = round(delay.mean(), 2)
delayed_orders = (delay > 0).sum()
delay_rate = round((delayed_orders / total_orders) * 100, 2)

# =========================
# SUPPORT KPI
# =========================

ticket_orders = df["ticket_category"].notna().sum()

negative_cases = df["sentiment"].fillna("").isin(
    ["Negative", "Very Negative"]
).sum()

customer_issue_rate = round((ticket_orders / total_orders) * 100, 2)
negative_sentiment_rate = round((negative_cases / total_orders) * 100, 2)

# =========================
# INVENTORY KPI
# =========================

avg_stock = round(df["stock_available"].fillna(0).mean(), 2)

low_stock = (
    df["stock_available"].fillna(0)
    <=
    df["reorder_level"].fillna(0)
).sum()

low_stock_rate = round((low_stock / total_orders) * 100, 2)

# =========================
# DATA QUALITY KPI
# =========================

orphan_customer_orders = df["customer_name"].isna().sum()
delivery_missing = df["delivery_status"].isna().sum()
ticket_missing = df["ticket_category"].isna().sum()

# =========================
# RISK ENGINE
# =========================

delivery_risk = delay_rate
inventory_risk = low_stock_rate
customer_risk = negative_sentiment_rate

operational_risk = round(
    delivery_risk * 0.35 +
    inventory_risk * 0.25 +
    customer_risk * 0.20 +
    cancel_rate * 0.20,
    2
)

# =========================
# OUTPUT
# =========================

return [{
    "json": {
        "total_orders": int(total_orders),
        "total_revenue": float(total_revenue),

        "completed_orders": int(completed_orders),
        "cancelled_orders": int(cancelled_orders),
        "cancel_rate": float(cancel_rate),

        "delivery_success_rate": float(delivery_success_rate),
        "delay_rate": float(delay_rate),
        "avg_delivery_cost": float(avg_delivery_cost),
        "avg_delay_days": float(avg_delay_days),

        "ticket_orders": int(ticket_orders),
        "customer_issue_rate": float(customer_issue_rate),
        "negative_sentiment_rate": float(negative_sentiment_rate),

        "avg_stock": float(avg_stock),
        "low_stock_rate": float(low_stock_rate),

        "orphan_customer_orders": int(orphan_customer_orders),
        "delivery_missing": int(delivery_missing),
        "ticket_missing": int(ticket_missing),

        "delivery_risk": float(delivery_risk),
        "inventory_risk": float(inventory_risk),
        "customer_risk": float(customer_risk),
        "operational_risk": float(operational_risk)
    }
}]

IF OBJECT_ID('enriched_orders','U') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE enriched_orders;

WITH d AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY delivery_id) rn
    FROM deliveries
),
t AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY ticket_id) rn
    FROM support_tickets
),
i AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY warehouse_id) rn
    FROM inventory
)

SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    o.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    c.customer_segment,
    c.region AS customer_region,

    o.product_id,
    o.quantity,
    o.order_value,
    o.payment_status,
    o.order_status,

    d.delivery_status,
    d.carrier,
    d.delivery_cost,

    d.expected_date,                   
    d.actual_date,                      
    DATEDIFF(DAY, d.expected_date, d.actual_date)
        AS delivery_delay_days,          

    t.category AS ticket_category,
    t.priority,
    t.sentiment,

    i.stock_available,
    i.reorder_level,
    i.daily_demand,
    i.supplier

INTO enriched_orders

FROM orders o

LEFT JOIN customers c
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

LEFT JOIN d
    ON o.order_id = d.order_id
   AND d.rn = 1

LEFT JOIN t
    ON o.order_id = t.order_id
   AND t.rn = 1

LEFT JOIN i
    ON o.product_id = i.product_id
   AND i.rn = 1;
